title: tablepeace — wedding seating chart where family privately flags who can't sit together
oneLiner: For engaged couples with 80–200 guests, it lets parents and the wedding party privately submit keep-apart and seat-together notes through personal links, then auto-seats the room for $19 instead of the couple guessing alone.
overlaps: none (nearest in portfolio: Open-Travel, a trip planner — no seating or event overlap); external: PerfectTablePlan, Seatbee, Zola
